title: UltraTex introduces multi-view diffusion framework for 4K PBR texture synthesis
summary: UltraTex proposes a cascaded diffusion pipeline that separates intrinsic material properties from lighting to generate complete 4K PBR texture sets from reference imagery, accompanied by an interactive Hugging Face demo.
research_notes:
Upload an untextured 3D mesh in OBJ or GLB format along with a single reference image to the hosted UltraTex interface on Hugging Face.

Inspect the predicted multi-view unlit albedo color and surface normal maps to verify geometric alignment across canonical viewpoints.

Export the resulting assembled 4K PBR map set containing albedo, normal, metallic, and roughness channels into a 3D digital content creation tool or real-time game engine.

Provide reference images with diffuse, neutral illumination to facilitate clean algorithmic separation of intrinsic surface color from specular highlights.

Prepare input meshes with clean, non-overlapping UV unwrapping before projecting generated multi-view feature maps into unified UV texture space.
